public_data_only.rationale: Source is the FMCSA Company Census File, a federally mandated public disclosure dataset published by the U.S. Department of Transportation under the FMCSA Data Dissemination Program (49 CFR 390.19). Available at data.transportation.gov and safer.fmcsa.dot.gov with no login or authentication required. Federal open data policy explicitly permits commercial redistribution.

no_pii.rationale: All contact data in this dataset — including physical address, phone, email, and officer name — was filed by the carrier as a mandatory federal business registration under 49 CFR Part 390. It is a condition of operating authority, not a voluntary personal disclosure. The FMCSA Data Dissemination Program was created specifically to enable B2B commercial use of this data by insurers, compliance vendors, freight intermediaries, and others. The 78.7% personal-domain emails and residential-style addresses are business registration contacts for owner-operators; they carry the same legal and ethical weight as any officer filing in a state business registry. All incumbent competitors (CarrierDetails.com, USTruckingCompanies.com, Fiverr data sellers) operate on this exact same dataset under the same legal framework. No SSNs, financial accounts, or non-public personal data are present.
caveats: company_officer_1 contains full legal names of business registrants. This is standard for B2B business registry data and is intentional under FMCSA rules. Product listing must disclose that officer names are included.

240 rows (1.5%) are Canadian and Mexican foreign carriers registered under NAFTA/CUSMA. These are still public FMCSA records and raise no additional compliance concern, but buyers should be able to filter by country.

source_url_on_every_row.rationale: 100% source URL coverage (15,770 / 15,770). All URLs point to the FMCSA SAFER CompanySnapshot for the corresponding DOT number. DOT number in URL verified to match row dot_number by data-steward. Non-negotiable requirement satisfied.

no_private_datasets.rationale: FMCSA Company Census File is a federally mandated public disclosure. No purchased, licensed, or access-gated datasets were used.

steward_issues_review.disposition: Accept steward recommendation. Undocumented legacy MCMIS codes are an upstream data quality issue, not a compliance matter. Engineer must add fleetsize_label decoded column before shipping.
Foreign carriers (Canadian/Mexican) are legitimately registered under FMCSA via NAFTA/CUSMA. Still public FMCSA records. Engineer must add country derived column for buyer filtering.
Six rows with non-US or malformed phone numbers. No compliance implications. Flag with phone_valid=false per steward recommendation.
One likely typo email (FREDNATIONALLLC@GMAOL.COM). Flag with email_suspect=true. Do not auto-correct. No compliance implications.
176 rows with empty carrier_operation. Upstream MCMIS gap. Retain rows, map to 'Unclassified' label.
255 inactive/pending rows. Not a compliance issue. Retain all; expose status_code for buyer filtering. Pending (P) rows are a product differentiator — early-stage leads.

mandatory_before_engineer_ships: Add fleetsize_label decoded column (A=1-6 vehicles, B=7-20, C=21-100, D=101-500, E=501+, else=Unknown)
Add country derived column (US state codes → 'US', Canadian province codes → 'CA', Mexican state codes → 'MX', other → 'UNKNOWN')
Add phone_valid boolean flag (false for the 6 malformed rows identified in issue #3)
Add email_suspect boolean flag (true for DOT 4576645 FRED NATIONAL LLC)
Product listing / Gumroad description must disclose: 'Includes business officer names as filed with FMCSA'
optional_enhancements: Consider marketing Pending (P) carriers as premium early-stage leads in listing copy

summary: Dataset PASSES all DataStructured hard compliance rules. Source is a federally mandated public disclosure database with explicit government authorization for commercial redistribution. No PII in the prohibited sense — all contact fields are mandatory business registration data filed under 49 CFR 390.19. Source URL on every row. Zero duplicates. Six minor data quality issues flagged by data-steward are inherited from the FMCSA upstream source and carry no compliance weight. Dataset is cleared for engineer handoff, subject to five mandatory pre-ship column additions and one disclosure requirement in the product listing.
